name: Automatic Configuration Form
description: Generate your custom module's configuration form automatically from its config schema definitions.
project_description:
The Schema form module can do everything that this module does, and more. I will continue to fix bugs in this module, but development of new features should happen in Schema form.

Generate your custom module's configuration form automatically from its schema definitions. Writing config forms is boring. Mostly they all look the same, or are not very important, especially if it's for simple or small modules or for a limited amount of users. So let's automate it!

Example: If your module has config, it will have a schema file, e.g. at my_module/config/schema/my_module.schema.yml. To create an automatic config form using this schema, create a Form class that extends Drupal\auto_config_form\AutoConfigFormBase and implements getSchemaKey() to return 'my_module.settings'. That's it: the form is generated from the config_object's mapping.

If you need to customize anything, override some of the methods of AutoConfigFormBase. To make the settings page accessible you add your own route (and a menu link if desired) yourself.

Drupal core compatibility: Drupal 10 uses the 1.x branch, Drupal 11 uses the 2.x branch (the two differ only in the typed-config-manager property declaration, forcing separate branches). Similar modules: Schema-based config forms, and Schema form.
